actions.desc: The goo teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 50 feet, leaving behind a wretched puddle in the space it previously occupied. A creature within 5 feet of the space the goo left must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and become poisoned until the end of its next turn. The first time a creature enters the puddle's space or if a creature starts its turn in the puddle's space it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned. The puddle lasts for 1 minute or until the goo that created it is killed.

actions.desc: The Yaga goo makes two pseudopod attacks. When its Foul Transit is available, it can use Foul Transit in place of one pseudopod attack.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +7 к попаданию, досягаемость 5 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 11 (2к6+4) дробящего урона плюс 3 (1к6) некротического урона.
actions.name: Pseudopod

actions.desc: When a creature the Yaga goo can see targets it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the goo, the goo can teleport to a puddle created by its Foul Transit, if that puddle's space is unoccupied, negating the damage from the attack. If it does, the attacker must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

traits.desc: The goo can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Amorphous

traits.desc: The goo has advantage on attack rolls against fey and any creature with the Fey Ancestry trait.

traits.desc: The goo can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

ru.description: Маленькая слизь, мировоззрение: нейтрально-злое. Класс доспеха: 14. Хиты: 85 (10к6+50). Скорость: ходьба 20 фт., лазание 20 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 11, ЛОВ 18, ТЕЛ 20, ИНТ 14, МУД 12, ХАР 11. Иммунитет к урону: некротической энергией. Иммунитет к состояниям: ослепление, очарование, глухота, истощение, испуг, положение ничком. Чувства: слепое зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 11. Показатель опасности: 5. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 3, действий: 4.
ru.name: Яга Гоо
